company.description:
Dharma Labs is a protocol for generic tokenized debt agreements. 

Dharma enables open, permissionless innovation in the lending industry, enabling aspiring entrepreneurs to build lending companies that take advantage of blockchain technology. Whether it’s a consumer lending platform, a margin lending network, or a platform for crowdfunding municipal bonds, you can quickly and securely build your lending company on Dharma.
